# seerr_jellyfin_library_settings (Resource)

Manage Jellyfin library enable/disable settings via `/api/v1/settings/jellyfin/library`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "seerr_jellyfin_library_settings" "example" {
  enabled_libraries = ["<library-id>"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled_libraries` (Set of String) Set of Jellyfin library IDs to enable in Seerr. Libraries omitted will be disabled.

### Optional

- `sync_on_read` (Boolean) Whether to pass `sync=true` when reading libraries from Jellyfin.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `libraries` (Attributes List) List of available Jellyfin libraries discovered on the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--libraries))

<a id="nestedatt--libraries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `libraries`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# In Terraform 1.5.0 and later, use an import block to import seerr_jellyfin_library_settings. For example:
#
# import {
#   to = seerr_jellyfin_library_settings.example
#   id = "jellyfin_library_settings"
# }

# Otherwise, use the terraform import command:
terraform import seerr_jellyfin_library_settings.example jellyfin_library_settings
```
